overview.description: Living reference for the container dependency surface. Open a sample page below.
overview.slotEmpty: No extension fills this slot yet. Fill it with deps.slots.register(sampleSlots.overviewPanel, Component).

navDesc.apiRegistry: Named service client registered in init
navDesc.query: Server state with useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient
navDesc.notifications: Push to the container notification bell
navDesc.events: Event bus: module events + container events
navDesc.extension: Slot, route override, and service wrapper demos

api.title: deps.api
api.description: Default axios instance created by the container with config.apiBase.
api.hint: Use deps.api for simple endpoints on the same baseURL; use apiRegistry when a service needs its own client or config.

apiRegistry.title: apiRegistry
apiRegistry.hint: Service factories receive the axios instance; components read it with useApiRegistry().get('module-sample').

store.title: Zustand store
store.hint: Reload the page: counter, note, and toggle are restored from localStorage.

toast.title: Toast
toast.description: Transient feedback via useToast (sonner under the hood).

modal.title: Modal
modal.description: Modal registered in init: deps.modal.register(sampleModals.info, Component).

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Push persistent notifications to the container bell (useNotifications).

events.title: Events
events.description: Emit module events and listen to container events.
events.containerSearchHint: Type in the topbar search box — this listens to containerEvents.searchChanged.

slots.title: Slots
slots.description: Extension points: modules declare slot names, extensions fill them.
slots.name: Slot name
slots.howTo: Fill it from an extension: deps.slots.register(sampleSlots.overviewPanel, Component).

logger.title: Logger
logger.description: Structured logging via useLogger — open the browser console.

extension.title: Extension points
extension.description: How an extension overrides this module — from the lightest tier to the heaviest.

slot.title: Tier 1 — Slot
slot.description: Extension fills sampleSlots.overviewPanel without touching the module.

service.title: Tier 3 — Service wrapper
service.description: Extension wraps createSampleService(apiRegistry.get('module-sample')) with its own rules.
